import re

with open('/tmp/parse_modified.py', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

old_int_handlers = """        elif type == 'i':
            s = r'-?\\d+'
            self._type_conversions[group] = int_convert_func
        elif type == 'd':
            s = r'-?\\d+'
            self._type_conversions[group] = int_convert_func
        elif type in ('o', 'n'):
            s = r'-?[0-7]+'
            self._type_conversions[group] = lambda s, m: int(s, 8)"""

new_int_handlers = """        elif type == 'i':
            # Support decimal, hex (0x), binary (0b), octal (0o) with optional base arg
            s = r'(?:0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|0[bB][01]+|0[oO][0-7]+|-?\\d+)'
            self._type_conversions[group] = _IntConvertFunc()
        elif type == 'd':
            s = r'-?\\d+'
            self._type_conversions[group] = int_convert_func
        elif type in ('o', 'n'):
            s = r'-?[0-7]+'
            self._type_conversions[group] = _OctalConvertFunc()"""

content = content.replace(old_int_handlers, new_int_handlers)

# Also update the 'b' (binary) type if it exists
if "elif type == 'b':" not in content or "elif type == 'b'" in content:
    old_b_type = """        elif type == 'b':
            s = r'-?[01]+'
            self._type_conversions[group] = lambda s, m: int(s, 2)"""
    
    new_b_type = """        elif type == 'b':
            s = r'-?[01]+'
            self._type_conversions[group] = _BinaryConvertFunc()"""
    
    content = content.replace(old_b_type, new_b_type)

with open('/tmp/parse_modified.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("R6 integer type changes applied successfully")
